project.name: Agent Console
project.summary: Self-hosted web console that runs Claude Code, Codex and Pi agent CLIs as chat threads. An Express + WebSocket server spawns provider processes, streams events to a vanilla-JS PWA, and runs GitHub issue automation, share intake, a secrets vault and usage accounting.

nodes.label: Web app (PWA)
nodes.summary: Vanilla-JS single-page app: chat threads, composer, dashboards, file viewer.

nodes.label: Chat UI
nodes.summary: Thread list, transcript rendering, composer, questions, notifications, service worker.

nodes.label: File viewer
nodes.summary: In-app file tree, renderer and editor; arch diagram renderer.

nodes.label: Automation page
nodes.summary: Issue lanes, auto-pick, assignment progress, job debug.

nodes.label: Dashboards
nodes.summary: Token/context dashboards, benchmarks, doctor, host, security, brain, ideas, session search.

nodes.label: Vault UI
nodes.summary: Secrets vault and passkey setup screens.

nodes.label: Console server
nodes.summary: Express + ws server (server/index.ts): REST API, live event stream, thread lifecycle.

nodes.label: Threads & API core
nodes.summary: HTTP/WS entry, auth, thread state, history, uploads, files, commands, questions, notifications.

nodes.label: Provider adapters
nodes.summary: Spawns and drives Claude Code, Codex (app-server RPC) and Pi; rate limits, titles, triage effort models.

nodes.label: Issue automation
nodes.summary: GitHub triage queue, job runner, review sweeps, scheduled tasks, auto-continue.

nodes.label: Share intake
nodes.summary: Fetches Instagram/X/Reddit/YouTube shares via camofox, yt-dlp and gallery-dl for sandboxed analysis.

nodes.label: Vault & privacy
nodes.summary: Encrypted secrets vault, passkeys, iron-proxy egress, transcript redaction.

nodes.label: Usage & telemetry
nodes.summary: Token accounting, pricing, latency/turn timing, headroom and context budgeting, benchmarks.

nodes.label: Host & ops
nodes.summary: Host metrics worker, doctor checks, security events, crash log, brain graph.

nodes.label: Agent tools bridge
nodes.summary: console-tool CLI backends, session search, cross-thread tool auth, window dispatch, Pi subagents.

nodes.label: Acode bridge
nodes.summary: HTTP bridge for the Acode Android editor plugin.

nodes.label: Acode plugin
nodes.summary: Android Acode editor plugin that talks to the console.

nodes.label: Design system
nodes.summary: Shared CSS tokens and helpers.

nodes.label: Ops scripts & CLIs
nodes.summary: console-tool CLI, release/deploy, triage data pipelines, telemetry backfills.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: Node test suite plus Playwright UI tests.

nodes.label: Agent CLIs
nodes.summary: claude, codex, pi processes spawned per thread.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.summary: Issues, PRs, webhooks, gh CLI.

nodes.label: LLM APIs
nodes.summary: OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, DeepSeek, Hugging Face.

nodes.label: Social sites
nodes.summary: Share sources fetched by intake.

nodes.label: Web Push / FCM
nodes.summary: Browser push notifications.

nodes.label: Playwright
nodes.summary: Headless browser for UI tests and share capture.

steps.note: User sends a prompt from the composer
API stores the message and starts a turn on the thread
Events pushed over WebSocket and rendered
Triage scores and queues the issue, job runner picks it
Launches an agent thread to work the issue
A shared link arrives via the PWA share target
Sandboxed analyzer thread reads the assets
